message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake) | Notes |
|------------|----------------------------------------|-------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) | Adds sweetness and structure |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) | Use a high‑quality Dutch‑process for richer flavor |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ tsp | Helps the cake rise; works with acidic cocoa |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ tsp | Provides extra lift |
| Salt | 1 ½ tsp | Balances sweetness |
| Eggs | 2 large | Room‑temperature for better mixing |
| Whole milk | 1 cup (240 ml) | Room‑temperature; can substitute with buttermilk for tang |
| Vegetable oil | ½ cup (120 ml) | Keeps cake moist; can use melted butter for richer taste |
| Vanilla extract | 2 tsp | Enhances chocolate flavor |
| Boiling water | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa and creates a moist crumb |
| Optional: 1–2 tbsp coffee |  | Intensifies chocolate flavor |

**Optional extras for extra richness:**
- ½ cup melted dark chocolate or chocolate chips (folded in after the batter is mixed)
- 1 tsp instant espresso powder (to deepen chocolate flavor)
- ½ cup sour cream or Greek yogurt (adds moisture and tang)

**Tips:**
- Make sure all dry ingredients are sifted together to avoid lumps.
- Beat the eggs and sugar until light and fluffy before adding dry ingredients.
- Add boiling water last; the batter will be thin, but that’s normal.
- Bake at 350 °F (175 °C) for about 30–35 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.

Enjoy your chocolate cake!
